fields_note: deploy: docker-compose|docker|binary|cli|script|iac|source; form: web|service|cli|desktop|cloud; gitmcp: 是否适合进 gitmcp.io 上下文收录

tools.name: reNgine
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/yogeshojha/rengine && cd rengine && docker compose up -d --build

tools.name: ARL
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/TophantTechnology/ARL && cd ARL/docker && docker compose up -d
tools.note: 原始仓库地址若已变更，可用镜像化版本 ki9mu/ARL-plus-docker 替代

tools.name: ARL-Plus
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/ki9mu/ARL-plus-docker && cd ARL-plus-docker && docker compose up -d

tools.name: Nemo
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/hanc00l/nemo_go && cd nemo_go && docker compose up -d

tools.name: ScopeSentry
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/Autumn-27/ScopeSentry-Scan && cd ScopeSentry-Scan && docker compose up -d

tools.name: CyberEdge
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/Symph0nia/CyberEdge && cd CyberEdge && docker compose up -d

tools.name: linglong
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/awake1t/linglong && cd linglong && docker compose up -d

tools.name: gosint
tools.name_zh: 分布式资产收集与漏洞扫描
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/1in9e/gosint && cd gosint && docker compose up -d

tools.name: Slack
tools.name_zh: 安全服务集成化工具平台
tools.install: 下载 Release 二进制或按仓库说明构建运行

tools.name: Yakit
tools.install: 下载官方安装包安装；服务端可用 docker 运行 yakit

tools.name: Vulfocus
tools.install: docker run -d -p 80:80 -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -e VUL_IP=<本机IP> vulfocus/vulfocus

tools.name: Vulhub
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/vulhub/vulhub && cd vulhub/<具体漏洞目录> && docker compose up -d

tools.name: Metarget
tools.install: pip3 install metarget && metarget cnv install cve-2019-5736

tools.name: GOAD
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/Orange-Cyberdefense/GOAD && cd GOAD && vagrant up

tools.name: TerraformGoat
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/HXSecurity/TerraformGoat && cd TerraformGoat/<场景> && terraform apply

tools.name: CI/CD Goat
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/cider-security-research/cicd-goat && cd cicd-goat && docker compose up -d

tools.name: DNSLog 平台
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/yumusb/DNSLog-Platform-Golang && cd DNSLog-Platform-Golang && go build && 配置域名后运行

tools.name: GoPhish
tools.install: docker run -d -p 3333:3333 -p 80:80 -v gophish_data:/data --name gophish gophish/gophish

tools.name: proxy_pool
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/jhao104/proxy_pool && cd proxy_pool && docker compose up -d

tools.name: rotateproxy
tools.install: 下载 Release 二进制后运行 rotateproxy

tools.name: Deadpool
tools.install: 下载 Release 二进制或按仓库说明构建运行

tools.name: frp
tools.install: 下载 Release 的 frps/frpc 二进制并配置 frps.toml/frpc.toml 运行

tools.name: nps
tools.install: 下载 Release 二进制，运行 nps 并访问 8080 管理面板

tools.name: goproxy
tools.install: 下载 Release 二进制后按 proxy 命令运行

tools.name: Axiom
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/pry0cc/axiom && cd axiom && 按说明配置云厂商后部署实例

tools.name: f8x
tools.install: bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ffffffff0x/f8x/main/install.sh)" 或克隆后运行

tools.name: Ehoney
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/seccome/Ehoney && cd Ehoney && 使用仓库内 docker-compose 部署

tools.name: DarkAngel
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/Bywalks/DarkAngel && cd DarkAngel && docker compose up -d

tools.name: 洞态 IAST
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/HXSecurity/DongTai && cd DongTai && docker compose up -d

tools.name: DependencyCheck
tools.install: 下载官方 CLI zip 或使用 Maven/Gradle 插件运行 dependency-check

tools.name: xray
tools.install: 下载官方 xray 二进制并运行 xray webscan --listen 127.0.0.1:7777

tools.name: KubeHound
tools.install: 下载 Release 二进制后运行 kubehound dump / graph

tools.name: watchvuln
tools.install: 下载 Release 二进制并配置推送渠道后运行

tools.name: NGCBot
tools.install: git clone https://github.com/ngc660sec/NGCBot && cd NGCBot && 使用仓库内 docker-compose 部署
